name: app-hand-held-journey-day-planner-close-up
title: Journey Day Planner in Hand
whatItIs: A close-up of a hand holding a phone showing a Journey screen: a week date strip with a black selected date, a dashed lilac insight card and a medication task list, on a light grey background.
whatItMeans: Big date bubbles and clear cards make the day feel manageable, and the dashed lilac card gives friendly guidance.
techniques: Selected date as a black glossy pill
Dashed outlined card for AI insight
Tight crop on the top of the screen

vocabulary.definition: A row of days with the current one highlighted.
